body: A record literal names every field of its type, and no other.

author: reek
body: Both halves of this were silent until 2026-07-14, and both were the same mistake wearing different clothes: the emitter writes the fields it was given and leaves the rest as __alloc left them, which is zero.

author: reek
body: A field MISSPELLED was dropped on the floor and the field the author meant to set kept its zero. CDX2005 already existed for exactly this mistake on a field access; the literal was the one place it was never raised.

author: reek
body: missing-one is CDX2006. wrong-name is CDX2005, and it is also CDX2006, because naming a field that does not exist necessarily leaves a real one unnamed.
